positions.name: IdLessMemorySlugGeneration
positions.frame: what must the pipeline do when a memory arrives without an explicit id, and how must it get to a committed file?
positions.why: src-1 states the condition (no explicit id field) and src-2 directs what the pipeline must do under it: generate a slug through the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, then commit the file. Both read in the direction of id generation for id-less submissions. The group holds a condition and a requirement, and no tension. No existing structure or strata offer a home, so `under` is omitted.
